title: UN Commission finding on intentional mistreatment of hostages
summary: The Commission assessed physical and psychological mistreatment of hostages held in Gaza.
claim: The Commission found that hostages were intentionally mistreated to inflict physical pain and severe mental suffering, including physical violence, sexual violence, forced isolation, deprivation, threats and humiliation.
legal_characterization: Factual and legal finding by a UN commission of inquiry; not a judicial judgment or individual conviction.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 111 of A/79/232. The record is limited to the Commission's finding about intentional mistreatment and keeps that institutional attribution explicit.
